commands.summary: 7/7 finite horizon tests passed: shift-append recurrence for h=1 (384 free) and h=2 (768 free), mathematical enclosure soundness, no-drift fixed anchor certificate binding, bound sufficiency, volume contrast, adversarial drift witness & step gap rejection, and validation ablation
All 238/238 Week 4 specialized unit tests passed cleanly
214/214 protected files verified clean and intact

requirement_evidence.evidence: Implemented FiniteHorizonDomain with shift-append recurrence: for h=1, window is [Z0[:, 64:], V1] with 384 fixed prefix coordinates and 384 free tail coordinates; for h=2, after two stride-64 steps, the entire window is replaced by [V1, V2] with 768 free coordinates. Verified by test_c01_shift_append_recurrence_and_dimensions.

Mathematical sound enclosure established for all admitted states: [P, L1] <= Z1 <= [P, U1] for h=1, and product-set outer relaxation [L1, L2] <= Z2 <= [U1, U2] for h=2. Verified by test_c02_mathematical_enclosure_soundness.

Certificate binds fixed anchor coordinates and anchor_step. On hit reuse, anchor_step is NOT updated and age is NOT reset. Certificate deterministically expires when current_step > anchor_step + max_age, forcing reference fallback. Verified by test_c03_certificate_binding_and_no_drift_expiry.

All 11 lower margin bounds must remain strictly positive for certificate issuance. Horizons h >= 3 are explicitly unsupported and fail closed with HORIZON_EXCEEDED. Verified by test_c04_bound_sufficiency_and_unsupported_horizon_fail_closed.

Contrast analysis proves structured wave domain restricts uncertainty to a 384-dimensional submanifold with zero prefix width, eliminating 2^384 volume expansion compared to isotropic 768-dimensional box. Verified by test_c05_wave_vs_full_box_comparison.

Adversarial drift witness demonstrates that floating-anchor / re-centering policies permit cumulative label corruption, whereas our strict No-Drift fixed anchor policy deterministically expires and forces reference fallback, preserving 100% decision agreement. Out-of-order step arrivals trigger FALLBACK_UNSUPPORTED. Verified by test_c06_adversarial_drift_witness_and_step_gaps.

Dimension growth measured (h1=384, h2=768, 2.0x ratio). Empirical reachability evaluated on 50 consecutive triplets of HAPT validation split (100% h1 prefix match, 100% consecutive chain, 0% anchor overlap at h2). Artifact output/week4/week4_initial_20261103/horizon_validation.json generated. Verified by test_c07_validation_ablation_and_artifact.

scientific_dispositions.H12_matched_geometry: CONFIRMED: Finite-horizon domain matches physical sensor dynamics: 50% overlap at h=1, full displacement at h=2.
scientific_dispositions.H15_fixed_anchor: CONFIRMED: Fixed anchor invariant eliminates cumulative floating drift.
scientific_dispositions.H16_deterministic_expiry: CONFIRMED: Expiry at anchor_step + max_age guarantees timely fallback to trusted model.
scientific_dispositions.H17_step_specific_enclosure: CONFIRMED: Outer product-set box preserves sound enclosure across multi-step sequences.
scientific_dispositions.H19_fail_closed_geometry: CONFIRMED: Unsupported horizons (h>=3), non-causal queries, and stream boundary crossings fail closed.

limitations: At h=2, the outer box enclosure uses the product set T1 x T2, which ignores cross-step temporal auto-correlation between V1 and V2, resulting in conservative outer volume relaxation.
Horizons h >= 3 are not certified because over-approximation accumulation causes LiRPA lower margins to become non-positive on HAPT sensor dynamics.
